document.about: Lutron Maestro fluorescent multi-location dimmer submittal sheet. Page 1 sets two wiring diagrams one over the other, and under them, in its footer, the LUTRON wordmark drawn as shapes beside the form's title.

notes: #201: the wordmark's letters joined the diagrams by reach, and the region took the form's title, `SPECIFICATION SUBMITTAL P/N 369-116 Rev. A`, as the diagrams' label; with the wordmark apart, its last letter read as a checkbox before the title.

checks.issue: `SPECIFICATION SUBMITTAL P/N 369-116 Rev. A` was a Figure.
